thread:
Maria R: Quick perf summary from this morning's multi-region run (h100 vs a100, us-east/us-west/eu-west). p50s mostly stable but p95 in us-west jumped after edge routing change, attaching charts.
Daniel C: which model + quant and batch? link to charts?
Maria R: llama3-xl, int8 (GPTQ-ish), batch=1, kv-cache warm, run=tail-heavy prompts. charts: https://redwood.internal/s/2263104321/perf
Cheng L: numbers please — p50/p95 per region & GPU?
Maria R: pasted below (median / 95th):
- us-east: H100 p50 78ms p95 210ms; A100 p50 110ms p95 320ms
- us-west: H100 p50 120ms p95 760ms (spiky after edge mux); A100 p50 150ms p95 980ms
- eu-west: H100 p50 95ms p95 240ms; A100 p50 130ms p95 360ms
Samir: that us-west p95 is wild. did the new edge mux add an extra hop/proxy? :thinking_face:
Maria R: yes — infra rolled the new routing policy at 02:10, it prefers local pop but inserts a routing proxy for stateful KV. extra serialization + NATS hop adds ~35-45ms median, but p95 amplifies due to request queuing on proxy.
infra-bot: deployment infra/routing-mux v2 promoted to us-west at 2026-03-19T02:10Z
Daniel C: kernel choices? you ran fused attention on H100?
Maria R: ran two kernel configs: default (aten-attn) and fused-mha. fused gave ~15-20% p50 improvement on H100, but p95 impact negligible vs network tail — so kernel wins reduce median but can't fix routing tail.
AJ: any quality delta from int8 quant? evals-bot summary?
evals-bot: evals run 2263104300: LLM-eval-suite: rouge/bertscore delta <0.6% vs fp16 for typical prompts; hallucination rate unchanged within noise.
Cheng L: capacity sizing implications?
Maria R: practical takeaway: increase reserved headroom in us-west by ~25% to hit p95 SLA, or push tail traffic to eu-west/us-east via routing policy for user buckets sensitive to latency. For Dedicated sizing, assume a100 needs ~1.3x GPU count vs h100 for same throughput; but p95 dominated by network in this case so CPU/proxy scaling matters too.
Samir: short-term mitigation: revert routing mux in us-west or enable direct-path for inference traffic. long-term: add proxy autoscale + request queue cap.
Daniel C: can you drop the curl repro for infra to reproduce latency pattern?
Maria R: yes — small repro: 
``` 
curl -s -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "x-region: us-west" \
  -d '{"model":"llama3-xl","input":"<tail prompt>","stream":false}' \
  https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate
```
AJ: I'll run with and without fused kernel + tcpdump to show extra hop.
Maria R: thanks — opened infra ticket: INF-3492 and pinned charts + p95 histograms. tagging @Samir for routing revert decision. :warning:
Samir: ack, will check revert window and autoscale knobs. will update INF-3492.
Maria R: TL;DR: kernel/quant improve p50, but p95 in us-west is routing/proxy-induced. capacity plans must account for network tail when sizing Dedicated pools.
